name: light-workspace
description: The light repository: @lightstart/light in packages/light, the workspace packages native apps share, the examples, the benchmarks and the website.

scripts.check: npm run check:root && npm --prefix packages/light run check && npm --prefix packages/components run check
scripts.coverage:tasks: cd examples/tasks-tui && node ../../packages/cli/bin/light.js app && cd ../.. && node packages/light/native/coverage.js examples/tasks-tui/.light/main.ts --allow-dynamic
scripts.verify:packages: npm run packages:check && npm run packages:typecheck && npm run packages:test && npm run packages:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:root && npm --prefix packages/light run verify && npm run coverage:tasks && npm run verify:packages
